'''Moria Elward''' was a woman who managed a farm near [[Tar Valon]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Moria Elward}}

== Activities ==
She is put in charge of [[Sahra Covenry]], to keep her working on a farm so she can not give away the alibi [[Min Farshaw]] is using as Elmindreda. The Black Ajah finds out where Sahra is and kills Mistress Elward before torturing Sahra for information.{{ref/book|4|17}}
